title: Glowing headphones
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#00ffcc' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#00ffcc' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- headband -->
  <path d='M 22 52 A 28 28 0 0 1 78 52' fill='none' stroke='#00e5ff' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- headband highlight -->
  <path d='M 25 48 A 25 25 0 0 1 75 48' fill='none' stroke='#80ffff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left earcup cushion -->
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='60' rx='11' ry='14' fill='#ff4f9a'/>
  <!-- left earcup outer -->
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='60' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#ff7eb8'/>
  <!-- left earcup inner -->
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='60' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#ffd1e8'/>
  <!-- right earcup cushion -->
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='60' rx='11' ry='14' fill='#ff4f9a'/>
  <!-- right earcup outer -->
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='60' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#ff7eb8'/>
  <!-- right earcup inner -->
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='60' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#ffd1e8'/>
  <!-- left arm -->
  <rect x='26' y='55' width='8' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#00e5ff'/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <rect x='66' y='55' width='8' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#00e5ff'/>
  <!-- little sparkles -->
  <circle cx='15' cy='40' r='2' fill='#ffff80'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='40' r='2' fill='#ffff80'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='25' r='1.5' fill='#ffff80'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#80ffff'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#80ffff'/>
</svg>
